title: VMD- my personal dream game
author: GabDaGamer3
selftext:
Well imagine a game that allowed you to create a customizable vehicle and then allows ya to compete with bots or players so that you're able to actually see whose battle game ideas are the best

Well.. welcome to VMD- Vehicles of Mass destruction.. A Arena that allows you to put your best engineering ideas to battle with creations of other players (multiplayer mode still upcoming)

Ill be releasing this game soon for free so that anybody can enjoy it (since I feel uncomfy trying to take money for something I didn't fully develop)

Ofc AI played a HUGE role for this, but I had to use multiple models and optimize for the best output for the making of this game (as well as debug 100s of errors, which are still pretty evident in the game).. and as you can see, this game uses quite a lotta resources, which is kind of huge to ask for a potato PC.

Anyways, Im pretty happy with my overall game idea and execution and yeah.. 

Wish me luck guys.. still developing other parts of this game.
